title: Quietly Indulgent Brazilian Chocolate Brownies
description: Buttery and tender Brazilian brownies featuring dark chocolate chips, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection using a sous-vide method on a comal, these brownies are a delight to indulge in quietly.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 195 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, combine the sugar, melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract, whisking until smooth.
Add the flour mixture to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in the dark chocolate chips.
Pour the batter onto a preheated comal and spread evenly.
Place the comal in a large sous-vide bag and seal, making sure to remove as much air as possible.
Cook for 2 hours, then remove from the sous-vide machine and let cool completely.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
